---
title: "Multimodal Idiographic Network Models"
---

In this project funded by the *Dr. Elmar & Ellis Reiss Stiftung* (Reiss Foundation), we investigate new methodological approaches to integrate mobile sensing with ecological momentary assessment (EMA) data in dynamic person-specific network models. 
A central challenge that we aim to address in this project is the different temporal resolution of passive sensing data compared to EMA data.
Thus, our goal is to determine appropriate data preprocessing steps and modeling decisions when integrating individual time series data from different sources.
